items.name: Anonymous Gift
items.description: A thoughtful present appears on someone's desk — and they'll suspect exactly who you want them to.

items.name: Leaked Memo
items.description: A juicy memo finds its way to every desk in the office at once.

items.name: Documentary Crew Day
items.description: A film crew shadows the office until midnight. Everything that can happen, happens twice as often.

items.name: Better Cameras
items.description: Twice the coverage: the confessional booth catches twice as many cutaways. Permanent.

items.name: Aquarium
items.description: A calming presence. Agents near it feel a little more connected.

items.name: Arcade Cabinet
items.description: Two players, one high score, instant friendship — or trash talk.

items.name: Meditation Pod
items.description: Ten quiet minutes. Stress melts, and sometimes grudges do too.

items.name: Karaoke Machine
items.description: Nothing bonds an office like witnessing each other's rendition of a power ballad.
